dedupe_keys.name: central america food consumption score and reduced coping strategy index forecast by municipality accion contra el hambre gis4tech

description: This dataset gives forecast shares of households in each Food Consumption Score category (poor, borderline, acceptable) and each Reduced Coping Strategy Index category (acceptable, moderate, severe) for El Salvador, Guatemala, Honduras and Nicaragua, by country, department and municipality. It is produced by Acción contra el Hambre with GIS4tech and feeds the PREDISAN platform, which offers more detailed information. Coverage runs from January 2023 to April 2026, and the HDX entry was refreshed in August 2026. The data are free to download as a CSV from the Humanitarian Data Exchange under a Creative Commons Attribution licence. Caveats: values are model forecasts expressed as sample percentages, the method is documented on the PREDISAN platform, not in the file, and the update frequency is listed as irregular. Simulation uses: adding municipal food security levels to models of how drought, hurricanes or market shocks in the Central American Dry Corridor affect households, and prioritising areas for food assistance logistics. Related records: the Central America travel time to health centres (data-ach-central-america-travel-time-to-health-centres) comes from the same producer, and the WFP Food Consumption Score (data-wfp-food-consumption-score-38-countries) gives an earlier multi-country series.
